question:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

That which can’t be read.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Illegible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Illegible"** means something that cannot be read due to poor handwriting, faded print, or other reasons. (अस्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **The doctor's handwriting on the prescription was so illegible that the pharmacist had to call to confirm the medication.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word that means "that which can't be read" is **'Illegible'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Illegible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inaccessible **(अप्राप्य): Not able to be reached or entered.

 
 
• **Example:** The remote village was inaccessible due to heavy snowfall.
 
 
 
• **Incurable **(असाध्य): Not able to be cured or healed.
 
 
• **Example: **The disease was deemed incurable by the medical community.
 
 
 
• **Irrelevant** (अप्रासंगिक): Not connected with or relevant to something.
 
 
• **Example:** His comments were irrelevant to the topic being discussed.
 
 

 

222:T8d1,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
